title: Optimization Intake Orchestrator: SLA-aware signal enrichment and routing score
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers and high-volume self-serve teams submit optimization/advisory requests (batching/caching, quant profiles, routing policies). Current triage is manual, inconsistent, and slow for SLA-tiered customers. We need a single orchestrator that enriches inbound signals, scores requests against SLA and technical feasibility, and routes them into the appropriate delivery lane (self-serve guidance, concierge, dedicated engineering), with auto-escalation for high-risk/impact items.

This ticket defines the product spec and rollout plan for the Optimization Intake Orchestrator: a service + console workflow that interprets telemetry (latency percentiles, cost delta, error spikes), customer metadata (contract tier, data sensitivity, requested timeline), and automated model/knob heuristics to produce a routing score and recommended first-action. The outcome should reduce time-to-first-response for P0/P1 advisory requests by 60% and improve correct routing to concierge by 40% (fewer false positives).
scope_in: SLA-aware lane mapping and auto-escalation rules
UI: intake form and 'signal details' panel in Console
Basic feedback loop: acceptance/reject and reason captured for ML improvements
scope_out: Full ML classifier training pipeline (future ticket)
Automated remediation actions that change production knobs without human approval
Deep audit log retention beyond 90 days (compliance add-on)
proposed_solution:
Create an orchestration layer that: (1) normalizes inbound requests from Console intake, API, and email -> canonical 'signal' object; (2) enriches signals with runtime telemetry (last 24h latency/cost/error deltas), customer contract metadata (SLA tier, committed capacity), and quick feasibility checks (model size vs. requested quant profile, KV cache compatibility); (3) computes a weighted routing score (weights editable in Console per release) producing lanes: 'Immediate Concierge', 'SLA-Assisted', 'Self-Serve Guidance', 'Backlog'; (4) posts the routed ticket to Linear + notifies relevant Slack channel and updates Console route dashboard.

Key quadrant: scoring should prioritize customer SLA tier (+40%), production regressions (+30%), cost increase risk (+15%), and feasibility risk (+15%). We will ship with a simple linear weighting function and a ruleset override for enterprise accounts. Later we will iterate to an ML ranker once labeled data is available.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form and API maps to canonical signal with documented schema and examples
Router computes routing_score and lane outputs for a broad set of synthetic inputs (test vectors) and matches expected lanes in 90% of cases
Console shows inbound signal with enrichment fields (latency p50/p95, cost delta, contract tier) in the intake panel
Notifications are created in Linear for routed items and concierge slack channel is seeded
Playbook for concierge includes first-response SLA and handoff steps, stored in Confluence link provided
success_metrics: Median time-to-first-response for P0/P1 advisory requests reduced from current baseline by 60%
Percentage of requests correctly routed to concierge increases by 40% over baseline after 8 weeks
Rate of SLA breaches related to advisory intake decreases by 50%
Operator workload for triage team reduced (less than 30% of triage actions per week are manual overrides)
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Enrichment data gaps (telemetry not available for new customers) -> Mitigation: Fall back to contract metadata and require minimal manual fields in intake form
Risk: Over-triaging sends too many requests to concierge -> Mitigation: conservative default weights and monitoring dashboard with override controls
Risk: Security/compliance for enriched customer metadata -> Mitigation: security review (required) and KMS for stored PII fields
rollout_plan: Week 0: Feature-flagged backend deployed to staging; Console intake UX behind feature flag
Week 1-2: Pilot with 3 enterprise customers and internal concierge team; collect labeled routing feedback
Week 3-4: Widen to all enterprise accounts; enable automated Linear creation for routed items; observe metrics
Week 5-8: Open to select self-serve customers, refine weights, and add manual overrides based on pilot feedback

Keep initial scope narrow and high-impact: enrichment + routing + notifications. We will iterate on automation and ML after we instrument feedback and collect labeled outcomes.
